content.title: Laser Photonics to deliver repeat order of cleantech system to Acuren
content.summary: Laser Photonics (LASE) announces the completion of “another significant order” from Acuren, a provider of asset protection services through engineering consulting and nondestructive testing. “We are thrilled to see Acuren as a returning customer. We take pride in being a trusted provider of advanced laser technology for surface preparation in the nondestructive testing sector. Laser Photonics is looking forward to further this collaboration and deliver exceptional value,” said John Armstrong, LP
